name: The Lost Caravan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I was stunned during the attack by the Lost Ones, but before my sight went black I spied one of our wagons being dragged to the Fallow Sanctuary, the lost one village to the north.

A caravan chest with valuable reagents was in that wagon, reagents vital to the studies of the wizards of Nethergarde Keep.  Find the chest and get those reagents, adventurer.  Get them and bring them to me.
narrative.objectives: Find the Caravan Chest in the Fallow Sanctuary, obtain the Wizards' Reagents and bring to Watcher Biggs.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, you found them! With these, the wizards in Nethergarde may continue their work. I do not know what it is that they do, but it is linked to the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands, and is vital to the security of the Alliance.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the wizard's reagents, adventurer?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 35 to 42, 11,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Encroaching Wildlife
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Young Sawtooth Crocolisks, 10 Sorrow Spinners and 10 Swamp Jaguars then return to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: The Lost Caravan
quests.objectiveText: Find the Caravan Chest in the Fallow Sanctuary, obtain the Wizards' Reagents and bring to Watcher Biggs.

quests.name: Driftwood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 pieces of Sundried Driftwood to Watcher Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Deliver the Shipment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Shipment to Nethergarde to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.
